title: Blocks have feelings
description: Blocks Have Feelings is a comedy mod that gives every block in the game a dramatic personality.
body:
Blocks Have Feelings is a comedy mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 that gives every block in the game a dramatic personality.

Features:

Mining a block triggers a random pain reaction in chat — different block types have unique lines. Dirt complains about its earthworm roommates, stone lectures you about millions of years of geology, wood mourns its tree rings, diamond acts like royalty, and glass blames you for seven years of bad luck.

Walking over blocks makes them insult you — they will question your diet, mourn their crumbling structure, and beg you to take a different route. 1% chance when mining any block: it comes to life as a custom entity that looks exactly like the block you broke, chases you down, and deals damage. It is small, angry, and absolutely ridiculous.

Full German and English localization — language switches automatically with your game language setting. This mod adds no new items, no progression system, and no balance changes. It is purely here to make you feel guilty about mining.

Why download it? If you want to turn a normal Minecraft session into a comedy show, this mod is for you. It is perfect for streamers and content creators looking for unscripted reactions, multiplayer servers where friends can laugh at each other's chat spam, or anyone who finds it funny that a humble dirt block can call you fat. Lightweight, server-friendly, and zero gameplay disruption beyond the chat.
